experiment.fixedPreexistingRanking: BM25 title*2+abstract*1, k1=1.2,b=0.75, query frozen in earlier protocol and no human labels used for ranking
experiment.firstEligibleTrigger: at least ceil(10% * N) screened; at least one positive identified; last ceil(pct*N) screened have no positive at the chosen endpoint
experiment.noTrigger: if never eligible, the full N records are screened; this is no earlier stop
experiment.secondaryIndependentCondition: at any suggested stop calculate original boundFiniteScreeningRecall with p observed, excluded observed and unresolved N-inspected, under a hypothetical complete source frame; never grant stop authority
experiment.evalOnly: actual true recall, missed sources, cumulative positives, inspected counts, screen fraction; a retrospective oracle is used ONLY after the proposed stop to judge its performance
experiment.baselineRandomization: original original-corpus xorshift32 Fisher-Yates PRNG seeded 20261027 + 2654435761 * (ordinal+1), sorted PMID before shuffling, same seeds as earlier pilot
experiment.successCriterion: exhibit any actual early heuristic stop with true recall below 95% as a falsifying counterexample to unconditional 7% stopping
limits: Not the full four-phase SAFE protocol, no second model, key-paper authority or adaptive active-learning training.
Static BM25 is a deliberately weak, fixed ranking; these results do not estimate any ASReview model's ability.
The protocol cannot assert any authorization to stop screening, even for a hypothetical source-complete finite corpus.
Three tasks from the same Cohen medicine collection are not independent scientific domains.
Custom/open source data rights do not authorize republishing abstracts; output aggregate metrics only.
This is a retrospective simulated sequential revelation of existing labels, not an authenticated live reviewer.
